dimensions.assessment: Affects Federally Qualified Health Centers, Rural Health Clinics, Medicare beneficiaries, Medicare Advantage enrollees, and Medicare administrative contractors nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: Federally qualified health centers... rural health clinics... Medicare Advantage enrollees

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts payment rates to equal 100 percent of estimated reasonable costs and standardizes FQHC telehealth and Medicare Advantage wraparound payments.
dimensions.evidence: prospective payment rates... is equal to 100 percent of the estimated amount of reasonable costs

dimensions.assessment: Alters Medicare reimbursement structures and payment rates for FQHCs and RHCs, potentially increasing federal Medicare outlays to meet reasonable cost estimates.
dimensions.evidence: estimated aggregate amount of prospective payment rates... is equal to 100 percent of the estimated amount of reasonable costs

dimensions.assessment: Amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act regarding Medicare payment systems, telehealth rules, and FQHC guidance requirements.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to modify payment rates under the Federally qualified health center prospective payment system

dimensions.assessment: Sets permanent statutory payment reforms and ongoing operational adjustments for Medicare health center reimbursements starting in 2027 and 2028.
dimensions.evidence: furnished in 2028... on or after January 1, 2027

missing_information: Exact scorekeeper estimates of federal budgetary impact or cost projections
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies Medicare payment rates and telehealth policies for Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) and Rural Health Clinics, directs data collection, establishes a working group, and requires FQHC guidance and a Comptroller General report.
